description: Review of computer networking. Mechanisms including interprocess communication and remote procedure call. Distributed operating systems design problems; kernels and microkernels, process models, virtual memory, naming and protecting. Distributed file systems. Fundamental problems in distributed computing: naming, ordering of events, replication and atomicity. Case studies.

      • CSC450 - Computer Communications and Networks (1.5)
      • CENG460 - Communication Networks (1.5)
      • ECE363 - Communication Networks (1.5)
      • ECE458 - Communication Networks (1.5)
